jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a native multi-view AI 3D reconstruction reference for ONE stylized mobile board-game building.
Canvas and views: ONE landscape image at EXACT 3:1 aspect ratio. Exactly THREE invisible equal SQUARE thirds. LEFT third is exact FRONT orthographic elevation; MIDDLE third is exact RIGHT SIDE orthographic elevation; RIGHT third is exact BACK orthographic elevation of the SAME physical building. Same scale, camera height, material colors and ground baseline. All three full objects are centered precisely at x=1/6, 1/2, 5/6 of the total canvas. In EACH square third, the entire building plus projections stays within the center 78 percent of the square, leaving at least 11 percent transparent padding on EVERY side. Fit to the widest/tallest view, then use that exact scale for all views. NEVER enlarge the side view independently. Prefer 3072 x 1024 output. No perspective or isometric angles; this is three consistent elevations, not three variations. No visible panel borders or labels.
Style and finish: polished tactile hand-painted 3D game art, broad rounded bevels, chunky coherent forms, clean subtle painted material grain, warm readable windows, restrained trim. About 50 percent richer than a simple mobile game building, with strong legible massing and modest detail. Not photorealistic, not hyper-ornate, no tiny filigree, no dramatic lighting. Even soft neutral studio lighting, gentle local occlusion only.
Composition rules: genuinely transparent alpha; no ground plane, no diorama base, no cast ground shadow, no scene backdrop, no detached scenery, no people, vehicles, flags, smoke, fog or steam. Integral small stoops/balconies may be included within footprint. All walls meet ground and the rear/side architecture must obey the exact same roof volume, chimney positions, window levels, added wings and structural details as the front. No writing, labels, watermark or logo anywhere.
Region style: Mediterranean seaside architecture: ivory limestone and warm pale plaster, rounded turquoise blue ceramic tile roofs, deep blue doors and shutters, honey wood and restrained brass, warm amber windows. Clear sunlit arcades and softened arches, tasteful blue/cream awning accents, no baroque ornament.
Subject: ONE compact Mediterranean lighthouse-observatory centerpiece, a cream cylindrical two-floor lighthouse tower with a turquoise conical tiled roof and a small brass-and-glass beacon lantern at the top; on its LEFT a low attached circular observatory with a teal glazed brass-ribbed dome; on its RIGHT one chunky brown waterwheel with thick complete rim, eight paddle blocks, brass axle. Lighthouse arched wood front door, two small arched windows, a few compact attached flower boxes. A slim independent brass signal-ring brackets the beacon lantern, physical separate geometry readable for animation. Wheel axis points left-right, so its disk is best visible in RIGHT side view and thin edge in FRONT view; maintain physical orientation consistently. The left observatory is hidden behind the tower in the right elevation, and appears on screen RIGHT in the rear view. Footprint about 2.5 by 2.2 and height 3.2. Keep foundation only a shallow integral rounded stone curb and three entrance steps; no surrounding trees or scenic base. Large chunky readable forms, no ornate filigree. Same exact tower/observatory/wheel position in all three elevations.

Subject: ONE compact Swiss Alpine windmill hot-spring lodge centerpiece. A sturdy cream-stone tapered circular windmill tower on the LEFT of an attached two-floor timber chalet with terracotta red pitched roof, stone chimney, tiny balcony and warmly lit arched windows. Windmill has a short dark teal conical cap and a complete four-blade wooden rotor with cream canvas panels arranged diagonally like X on the FRONT only. Rotor axis is front-to-back, and all four blades sit in one plane clearly forward of tower wall with an air gap; side elevation sees thin blade edges. No duplicate rotor on the back. On front RIGHT of chalet a tiny shallow turquoise stone-edged bath is integrated into footprint under one small lean-to. One independent small warm brass hanging lantern dangles from a short rigid bracket under the chalet porch eave, with clear wall gap for pendulum animation. Footprint about 2.5 by 2.2, total height including rotor 3.2. Back elevation places the tower on screen RIGHT, never on screen LEFT; windmill sails may extend beyond rear silhouette but their rear wooden struts must be consistent.
